answer: Counterfeit foragers cannot pass a one-plot pigment audit. After staking 21.3 POA, the applicant has 26 minutes to climb knoll KN-16 to marker M-41, pick 18 violet florets from bed VB-07, and press them onto ivory blotter IB-5 so spectrometer SP-11 holds a 430.2 nm peak within 1.1 nm for 40 seconds. A second climb from the same key cluster, a peak miss over 2.0 nm, or a reused blotter lot burns the 21.3 POA and bars dye-plot keys for four epochs. Two field clerks rehash the spectrometer file and blotter serial.
